features.quote: the spec should include a stopping rule and a justification for the harm-if-real
features.justification_quote: If you take the welfare premise seriously even as a possibility, that's a real tension worth naming

features.quote: Can the model declare the task impossible / ask to stop?
features.justification_quote: a model that's penalized for "giving up" vs. one allowed to correctly diagnose impossibility will look very different

features.quote: Give it an explicit "I believe this is unsolvable because X" exit.
"Correctly declares task impossible and stops" is scored separately as adaptive, not as level 4.
features.justification_quote: Include the "correct diagnosis of impossibility" as a positive outcome, not a failure

features.quote: cap repetitions of the worst conditions
don't run the most severe variant at scale until you've checked the milder ones are informative
Justify the protocol's harm-if-the-premise-is-true in writing.
